title: Wire workbench shell to real adapters — workbenchStore
description: The WorkbenchShell currently uses MOCK_CONNECTIONS/MOCK_SCHEMAS/MOCK_TABS. Build a workbenchStore (TanStack Store) that: (1) loads SavedConnections from Dexie, (2) connects via getTransport(connectionId), (3) populates SchemaTree from adapter.listTables/describeTable through transport, (4) manages tabs with per-tab connectionId + SQL state, (5) wires EditorPane to CodeMirror using getDialect(activeTab.engine), (6) Run button executes transport.query and renders results in ResultsGrid, (7) per-tab cancel via cancelToken. This supersedes the single-client assumption in workspaceStore for the desktop surface.
close_reason: WorkbenchShell wired to real adapters via workbenchStore (src/stores/workbenchStore.ts). Multi-connection store loads SavedConnections from Dexie, connects via getTransport(connectionId), populates SchemaTree from transport.listTables/describeTable, manages per-tab SQL + results. EditorPane uses CodeMirror with getDialect(engine) and Run executes transport.query → ResultsGrid. Mock data removed entirely. Verified: tsc clean, web build clean, electron-vite build clean, eslint clean. Interactive Electron testing deferred (no display in this environment).

close_reason: WorkbenchShell implements: split navigator (ConnectionList top + SchemaTree bottom with filter box + expandable tables to columns), EditorPane with tab bar + connection pill + run/save, NewConnectionDialog (engine-aware), SaveQueryDialog (form with Enter-to-save). Prototype at src/features/_prototype/ deleted. Desktop route wired: routes/index.tsx renders WorkbenchShell when window.electronAPI detected, HomePage otherwise (web build unchanged). Shell uses mock data; functional adapter wiring tracked separately. Verified: tsc clean, electron-vite build clean.

title: Redis support (deferred)
description: Redis is a command engine, not SQL: no query(sql), no tables/columns. Needs a parallel interaction model (command console, key browser, per-type value views). Deliberately out of Phase 1 scope so it does not distort the DbAdapter design. Decision Q3.
close_reason: Deferred by design (Decision Q3): Redis is not SQL and would distort the DbAdapter interface. Out of Phase 1 scope. Revisit only if there's clear demand.
